queries.purpose: Root cause: Payment Success Rate (attempt level) by bank, payment_method, merchant_category, region for both periods
queries.sql:
SELECT
    CASE WHEN t.created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-11-09 00:00:00' AND t.created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-11-16 00:00:00' THEN 'current' WHEN t.created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-11-02 00:00:00' AND t.created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-11-09 00:00:00' THEN 'previous' END AS period,
    COALESCE(b.bank_name, 'UNKNOWN') AS bank,
    t.payment_method AS payment_method,
    m.category AS merchant_category,
    t.region AS region,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS numerator,
    COUNT(*) AS denominator
FROM transactions AS t
LEFT JOIN banks AS b ON t.bank_id = b.bank_id
LEFT JOIN merchants AS m ON t.merchant_id = m.merchant_id
WHERE t.status IN ('SUCCESS', 'FAILED')
  AND ((t.created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-11-09 00:00:00' AND t.created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-11-16 00:00:00') OR (t.created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-11-02 00:00:00' AND t.created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-11-09 00:00:00'))
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5
ORDER BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5

facts.text: Payment Success Rate (attempt level) moved from 90.38% (02 Nov 2026 - 08 Nov 2026, n=21,976) to 87.35% (09 Nov 2026 - 15 Nov 2026, n=22,213): -3.03pp (p < 0.001).
Decomposition at bank x payment_method level: within-segment rate effect -1.45pp, traffic-mix effect -1.58pp; sum -3.03pp equals the observed change (residual 1.0e-17).

Counterfactual (previous traffic mix, current segment rates): 88.80% vs 87.35% actual. Measured this way, performance accounts for -1.58pp and mix for -1.45pp; the symmetric split differs only because it shares the interaction term (+0.27pp) equally.
Zenith Bank: traffic share 12.21% -> 26.53%, success rate 80.10% -> 80.37% (below the 88.87% average); mix contribution -1.24pp.
Nova Bank | UPI: success rate 91.51% -> 79.73% (-11.77pp, p < 0.001) on 10.11% of current traffic; rate contribution -1.28pp.
Nova Bank | CARD: success rate 90.45% -> 88.03% (-2.42pp, p = 0.026) on 6.51% of current traffic; rate contribution -0.18pp.
Nova Bank | UPI failures with reason ISSUER_UNAVAILABLE: 18 -> 301 (8.29% -> 66.15% of the segment's failures).
Nova Bank | UPI daily success was well below its previous-period level (91.51%) on 11 Nov, 12 Nov, 13 Nov, 14 Nov.
Raw data gives 85.43% (n=22,713) vs 87.35% (n=22,213) on the trusted view for the current period (-1.92pp); 500 duplicate rows were excluded.
16 Nov is partially loaded (398 attempts vs ~3307/day) and was excluded from relative periods.

narrative.summary: Payment Success Rate (attempt level) fell 3.03pp, from 90.38% to 87.35%. The symmetric decomposition attributes -1.45pp to segment performance and -1.58pp to traffic mix.
observed: [F1] Payment Success Rate moved from 90.38% to 87.35% across the two periods, a change of -3.03pp.

[F2, F3] The symmetric decomposition assigns -1.45pp to the within-segment rate effect and -1.58pp to the traffic-mix effect. The counterfactual decomposition measures these effects differently because it allocates the interaction term differently.
[F4] Zenith Bank's traffic share rose from 12.21% to 26.53%, while its success rate changed from 80.10% to 80.37%, below the 88.87% average.

[F5, F7, F8] Nova Bank | UPI's success rate fell from 91.51% to 79.73%; ISSUER_UNAVAILABLE failures rose from 18 to 301. Its daily success rate was below its previous-period level on 11 Nov, 12 Nov, 13 Nov, and 14 Nov.
[F9] The raw current-period data gives 85.43% (n=22,713), while the trusted view gives 87.35% (n=22,213); 500 duplicate rows were excluded.
[F10] 16 Nov is partially loaded and was excluded from relative periods.

hypotheses.text: The Nova Bank | UPI deterioration and increase in ISSUER_UNAVAILABLE failures, concentrated on 11 Nov, 12 Nov, 13 Nov, and 14 Nov, are consistent with an issuer or network availability problem. Infrastructure telemetry is not available in this dataset to confirm this.
The shift toward Zenith Bank, whose success rate is lower but changed little, may reflect a routing change, campaign, or merchant onboarding. The data shows the shift, not its cause.

recommendations: Check Nova Bank | UPI issuer and switch availability and error logs for 11 Nov, 12 Nov, 13 Nov, and 14 Nov; assess failover routing for this segment while it is degraded.
Review routing rules, campaigns, and merchant onboarding associated with the shift toward Zenith Bank, and quantify the success-rate impact before retaining any change.
Investigate and fix the ingestion replay that creates duplicate transaction rows; use the trusted view for reporting until resolved.
